title: Production input handlers (OnDrawStart/OnDrawEnd + SetupInputComponent/BeginPlay wiring) are never executed by any test
detail: The suite binds the ForTest duplicates; the production bodies (mouse read, no-cursor guard, EIC cast, AddMappingContext) run only in PIE. The r1 blocker lived in exactly this untested wiring.
recommended_fix: Inject the cursor source (virtual or TestScreenPos) into OnDrawStart/OnDrawEnd and drive those; assert AddMappingContext registration in the test world.

title: UPPRunView runtime orchestration (rebuild-on-gen-change, dot-pool lifecycle, fit re-fit) has zero automated coverage
evidence: PPRunView.cpp:300-313: "const bool bTopologyChanged = Next.TopologyGen != CurSnapshot.TopologyGen;" ... "RebuildDotPool(); // ClearWorld wiped it (the pool=0 bug)" — PPViewGeometryTests.cpp:2: "// 9: UPPRunView had zero automation coverage — the road-anchor and dot-offset" — grep 'UPPRunView' across Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/ returns only that comment.
detail: The r2 extraction covers the pure math, but the pool=0 and same-tick-detection bugs were orchestration bugs in NativeTick — that stratum is still untested; recurrences ship undetected again.
recommended_fix: Extract the change-detection + pool-acquire/release decisions into pure functions (like PPViewGeometry) and pin them; drive NativeTick in a test world for the rebuild trigger.

title: BuildSnapshot's packet mapping (AtNode/Heading → From/ToNode, at-node branch, progress clamp) is untested
detail: The geometry tests pin PacketGridPos against hand-built snapshots, so a BuildSnapshot regression (swapped AtNode/Heading, wrong clamp) passes every automated test — dots would misplace in PIE only.
recommended_fix: Add a test that steps BuildProbeScenario, calls BuildSnapshot, and asserts From/ToNode/Progress against the known sim packet (golden scenario has one at the router at tick 100).

title: FPPCommandBus::DrawPipe snap-miss rejection branch (MissingNode → LastEditError) has no negative test
detail: Only the happy path through the bus is driven; the missed-snap rejection (the UI feedback contract) is never asserted through the bus — sim-layer rejections are covered elsewhere.
recommended_fix: Add a leg dragging from empty space: assert LastEditError == MissingNode, no pipe, empty action log.

title: FPPScreenFit::ScreenToGrid has zero test coverage and its only call site feeds a dead local
evidence: PPCommandBus.h:48: "PP::FIntPoint ScreenToGrid(const FVector2D &ScreenPos) const;" — PPRunGameMode.cpp:171: "const PP::FIntPoint EndGrid = MakeScreenFit(ViewportSize).ScreenToGrid(ScreenPos);" (EndGrid is never read afterwards; the intent uses snapped node ids).
detail: The inverse mapping is untested and effectively unused — dead code with an untested contract. MakeScreenFit's zero-viewport fallback is likewise asserted nowhere.
recommended_fix: Either delete the dead EndGrid + ScreenToGrid, or pin them: zero viewport falls back to 1280x720; ScreenToGrid(GridToScreen(p)) == p.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: e2e draw via seam, snap boundaries, geometry, golden, determinism all FULL. P1 ~80%: production input wiring NONE, view orchestration NONE, snapshot mapping NONE, bus rejection PARTIAL. Overall ~82%.
recommended_fix: Drive the production handlers via an injectable cursor source, extract + pin the view change-detection/pool logic, and assert BuildSnapshot against the golden scenario packet.
